headline_grade: A*AA / A*A*B (or AAA / A*AB with CS at A)
subject_required: None mandatory, but CS at grade A allows lower grade profile
epq_reduction: Grade A in EPQ, Core Maths, IB Extended Essay or additional AS may reduce offer
excluded_subjects: General Studies; Thinking Skills; Global Perspectives and Research; Critical Thinking; A level ICT or IT (do not qualify for lower level)
additional_conditions: A*AA or A*A*B; alternatively AAA or A*AB including computer science at grade A.
document_text: Nottingham A level entry requires A*AA or A*A*B; alternatively AAA or A*AB including computer science at grade A. Excluded subjects: General Studies, Thinking Skills, Global Perspectives and Research, Critical Thinking. A level ICT or IT do not qualify for the lower grade profile. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and GCSE English grade C/4 required.

headline_grade: 36 points or 766 in 3 HL; 34 with HL 6 CS
subject_required: HL computer science allows lower points
additional_conditions: 36 points overall or 766 in 3 HL Certificates. With HL computer science: 34 points including HL 6 in CS, or 666 in 3 HL including CS.
document_text: Nottingham IB entry requires 36 points overall or 766 in 3 Higher Level Certificates. If taking Higher Level computer science, 34 points including HL grade 6 in computer science, or 666 in 3 Higher Level Certificates including computer science. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and GCSE English grade C/4 required. IB Maths can substitute for GCSE Maths requirement.

additional_conditions: RQF Level 3 BTEC National Extended Diploma.
document_text: Nottingham RQF Level 3 BTEC National Extended Diploma entry requires D*DD. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and GCSE English grade C/4 required.

headline_grade: DD plus A* or D*D plus A in A level CS
subject_required: A level computer science required alongside
additional_conditions: RQF Level 3 BTEC National Diploma plus one A level.
document_text: Nottingham RQF Level 3 BTEC National Diploma and one A level entry requires DD plus A*, or D*D plus A in A level computer science. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and GCSE English grade C/4 required.

qualification_type: BTEC Extended Certificate with A levels
headline_grade: D plus A*A or D plus AA including A level CS
subject_required: A level computer science required alongside
additional_conditions: RQF Level 3 BTEC National Extended Certificate plus two A levels.
document_text: Nottingham RQF Level 3 BTEC National Extended Certificate and two A levels entry requires D plus A*A, or D plus AA including A level computer science. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and GCSE English grade C/4 required.

additional_conditions: Contextualisation already applied to Access to HE - no further grade reductions for contextual offer applicants.
document_text: Nottingham Access to HE Diploma entry requires passing with 42 Level 3 graded credits at Distinction and 3 Level 3 graded credits at Merit. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and GCSE English grade C/4 required. Contextualisation is already applied to Access to HE qualifications so no further grade reductions apply for contextual offer applicants.

additional_conditions: Home-UK fee status required. School must be in UK and non-independent. Must live in deprived area, or completed Sutton Trust programme, or have refugee status, or 3+ months in care. Minimum BBC applies.
document_text: Nottingham standard contextual offer is usually 1 grade lower than advertised entry requirements. Specific subject grades generally remain, so if the standard offer is AAA the contextual offer would be AAB. Eligibility requires Home-UK fee status and a non-independent UK school, plus one of: living in a high deprivation area, completing a Sutton Trust post-16 programme, refugee status, or more than 3 months in care. Applied automatically via UCAS. Offers cannot go below the university minimum of BBC at A level.

additional_conditions: Home-UK fee status required. School must be in UK and non-independent. Must have received Free School Meals, or completed a Nottingham outreach programme. Minimum BBC applies. Additional qualification reductions not applied on top.
document_text: Nottingham enhanced contextual offer is usually 2 grades lower than advertised entry requirements. Specific subject grades generally remain, so if the standard offer is AAA the enhanced contextual offer would be ABB. Eligibility requires Home-UK fee status and a non-independent UK school, plus one of: receiving Free School Meals in the 6 years up to end of key stage 4, or completing a Nottingham outreach programme such as Sutton Trust Summer School or Ambition 16-18. Applied automatically via UCAS. Offers cannot go below the university minimum of BBC at A level.

additional_conditions: Contextual offers cannot go below BBC at A level or equivalent for undergraduate courses. Only applies to Level 3 qualifications, not GCSEs.
document_text: Nottingham contextual offers will not be made below the university minimum grade requirement of BBC at A level or equivalent for undergraduate courses. Contextual offers only apply to Level 3 qualifications such as A levels and are not used to reduce GCSE requirements. Contextualisation is already applied to Access to HE qualifications with no further reductions.

headline_grade: Additional reduction possible with standard contextual offer only
epq_reduction: Grade A in EPQ, Core Maths, IB Extended Essay or additional AS
additional_conditions: Standard contextual offer applicants can combine an additional qualification reduction. Enhanced contextual offer applicants cannot. Offer cannot go below BBC minimum.
document_text: Nottingham allows students with a standard contextual offer to also receive a reduction for achieving grade A in an additional qualification such as EPQ, Core Maths (if not taking A level Maths), IB Extended Essay, or an additional AS level. Students with an enhanced contextual offer cannot receive further additional qualification reductions. In all cases the offer cannot go below the university minimum of BBC at A level.
